use_cases: Exhausting hot air from pitched roof spaces during summer
Passive ventilation of residential roof spaces through external gable end walls
Preventing moisture accumulation and condensation under pitched roof sheeting
not_for: Below ground or subfloor perimeter ventilation
Bushfire zones requiring non-compliant unmeshed apertures
Direct floor or ceiling internal room linings
retrieval.rag_summary:
Proctor Gable Vent represents passive external
ventilation louvres installed on exterior gable end walls to cross-ventilate
residential and commercial pitched roof spaces. By creating a natural convective
airflow path across the attic void, it expels trapped heat in summer and vents
moisture vapour in winter to mitigate condensation and mould growth. It
functions as a non-mechanical roof space ventilation component complementary to
eaves and ridge venting systems.
